svg.title: Bias variance decomposition
svg.desc: Stacked bands over model complexity: a thin dark band of constant noise at the bottom, a mid-grey bias squared band that shrinks to the right and a light variance band that grows; the accent line along the top is the expected prediction error, lowest at the accent dot.
